name: ORPHAN DRUG
source:
Main character dines at home with his partner. Protagonist feels ill, so he considers visiting a doctor or using a different means to feel better.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公和伴侣在家中用餐。他感到身体不适，于是考虑去看医生，或用另一种方法让自己好受一些。
